confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is sensitive to July peak season and trade-fair dates in Bologna. Euro-based prices are converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR. Tourist tax and mandatory fees are included in accommodation figures in approximate form. The FX observation (15 Oct 2026, 0.6955) was taken from a search summary of the RBA homepage and was not verified line-by-line against table F11.1. A 16 Oct 2026 figure from a third-party site was not used because it is not an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized northern Italian tourist and university cities such as Parma, Padua and Florence, with accommodation priced toward the higher end of that group because Bologna's July demand is strong and its hotel supply is limited.
